chunks: That is how We reward those who do good.

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: Those who do good / The doers of good

ai.seo_question: How does God reward those who do good?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse concludes the description of the believers who fight in the cause of Allah, affirming that divine recompense is not merely transactional but a manifestation of His inherent justice and generosity. Shia scholarship often links this 'reward for the doers of good' to the concept of *Jaza'* (recompense) which extends beyond the afterlife to include spiritual elevation and the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the covenantal relationship between God and the faithful.
